baseline.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActiveMemberCount FROM Members WHERE Status = 'Active';
SELECT TrainerID, FirstName, LastName, HourlyRate FROM Trainers WHERE HourlyRate > 40;
SELECT SUM(Amount) AS TotalCreditCardPayments FROM Payments WHERE PaymentMethod = 'Credit Card';
SELECT DISTINCT MemberID FROM Subscriptions WHERE PaymentStatus = 'Overdue';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS class_count FROM FitnessClasses WHERE Room = 'Studio A';
SELECT EquipmentID, EquipmentName, Category, PurchaseDate, Condition_, LastMaintained, Location FROM Equipment WHERE Condition_ = 'Under Maintenance';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CancelledSessions FROM PersonalTrainingSessions WHERE Status = 'Cancelled';
SELECT Price FROM MembershipPlans WHERE PlanName = 'Premium Monthly';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoShowCount FROM ClassBookings WHERE AttendanceStatus = 'No-Show';
SELECT MemberID FROM Members WHERE YEAR(JoinDate) = 2024;

SELECT m.MemberID, m.FirstName, m.LastName, COUNT(*) AS AttendedClassesCount
FROM ClassBookings cb
JOIN Members m ON cb.MemberID = m.MemberID
WHERE cb.AttendanceStatus = 'Attended'
GROUP BY m.MemberID, m.FirstName, m.LastName
ORDER BY AttendedClassesCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Amount),0) FROM Payments) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(AmountPaid),0) FROM Subscriptions) AS TotalRevenue;
SELECT t.TrainerID, t.FirstName, t.LastName, COUNT(*) AS class_count FROM Trainers t JOIN FitnessClasses fc ON t.TrainerID = fc.TrainerID GROUP BY t.TrainerID ORDER BY class_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActiveMemberCount FROM Members WHERE Status = 'Active';
SELECT mp.PlanName, COUNT(*) AS subscription_count FROM Subscriptions s JOIN MembershipPlans mp ON s.PlanID = mp.PlanID GROUP BY mp.PlanID, mp.PlanName ORDER BY subscription_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT EquipmentID, EquipmentName, Condition_, LastMaintained, Location FROM Equipment WHERE Condition_ <> 'Excellent';

SELECT SUM((pts.DurationMinutes/60.0) * t.HourlyRate) AS TotalPersonalTrainingEarnings
FROM PersonalTrainingSessions pts
JOIN Trainers t ON pts.TrainerID = t.TrainerID
WHERE pts.Status = 'Completed';

SELECT fc.ClassName, COUNT(*) AS AttendanceCount FROM ClassBookings cb JOIN FitnessClasses fc ON cb.ClassID = fc.ClassID WHERE cb.AttendanceStatus = 'Attended' GROUP BY fc.ClassID, fc.ClassName ORDER BY AttendanceCount DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT m.MemberID, m.FirstName, m.LastName, m.Email, s.PlanID, s.PaymentStatus FROM Members m JOIN Subscriptions s ON m.MemberID = s.MemberID WHERE s.PaymentStatus IN ('Pending', 'Overdue');

SELECT t.TrainerID, t.FirstName, t.LastName, COUNT(fc.ClassID) AS ClassCount
FROM Trainers t
JOIN FitnessClasses fc ON t.TrainerID = fc.TrainerID
GROUP BY t.TrainerID, t.FirstName, t.LastName
ORDER BY ClassCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.MemberID, m.FirstName, m.LastName, SUM(p.Amount) AS TotalPaid
FROM Members m
JOIN Payments p ON m.MemberID = p.MemberID
GROUP BY m.MemberID, m.FirstName, m.LastName
ORDER BY TotalPaid DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(AmountPaid), 0) AS TotalRevenue FROM Subscriptions WHERE PaymentStatus = 'Paid';

SELECT t.TrainerID, t.FirstName, t.LastName, COUNT(fc.ClassID) AS ClassCount
FROM Trainers t
JOIN FitnessClasses fc ON t.TrainerID = fc.TrainerID
GROUP BY t.TrainerID, t.FirstName, t.LastName
ORDER BY ClassCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MemberID) AS ActiveMemberCount FROM Subscriptions WHERE EndDate >= '2024-05-15';

SELECT p.PlanID, p.PlanName, SUM(s.AmountPaid) AS TotalPaid
FROM MembershipPlans p
JOIN Subscriptions s ON p.PlanID = s.PlanID
WHERE s.PaymentStatus = 'Paid'
GROUP BY p.PlanID, p.PlanName
ORDER BY TotalPaid DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT EquipmentID, EquipmentName, Category, Condition_, LastMaintained, Location FROM Equipment WHERE Condition_ IN ('Fair', 'Under Maintenance');
SELECT SUM(Amount) AS TotalPersonalTrainingRevenue FROM Payments WHERE Description LIKE '%Personal Training%';

SELECT fc.ClassID, fc.ClassName, COUNT(*) AS AttendanceCount
FROM ClassBookings cb
JOIN FitnessClasses fc ON cb.ClassID = fc.ClassID
WHERE cb.AttendanceStatus = 'Attended'
GROUP BY fc.ClassID, fc.ClassName
ORDER BY AttendanceCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT m.MemberID, m.FirstName, m.LastName, m.Email
FROM Members m
JOIN Subscriptions s ON m.MemberID = s.MemberID
WHERE s.PaymentStatus = 'Overdue';
SELECT TrainerID, FirstName, LastName, HourlyRate FROM Trainers ORDER BY HourlyRate DESC LIMIT 1;
